title: Bassinet to cot to toddler bed...other than Stokke Sleepi System
label: gear

posts.body:
I'm also looking for this! Sadly it seems that the Stokke is the only option available. If I come across any alternatives, will definitely let you know! 

Just FYI - i learned that with the Stokke system you can convert "up" only. The bassinet-->crib-->junior bed. But if you purchase the crib system outright, it is NOT possible to convert it into the smaller bassinet because they do not sell the conversion kit.
